name: AppaList

sources.title: Submit page — 'Log in to Submit' with Google OAuth only

requirements: Directory focuses on practical AI work apps (writing, design, marketing, automation, productivity)
Google account sign-in is mandatory before the submission form is shown
preparation: Tool name, URL, description, logo, and category
workflow: Log in with Google or create an account via /signup
Complete the post-login submission form (not publicly visible)
watchFor: No pricing or guidelines page is public; the form is entirely behind the login wall
Identical template and categories as aitechviral.com, unitelist.com, weliketools.com, aixcollection.com — same likely operator; SubmitSaaS ad present
Whether listing is free or paid could not be verified without logging in
countsAsLive: Tool page appears on appalist.com under /latest or a category and is reachable without login
unknowns: Whether submission is free or paid after login
Form fields, review process, and turnaround time
Whether a badge or backlink is required
